scripts.title: Message Typewriter with sound
scripts.script:
local fullText = "Put your message here"
    local message = Instance.new("Message")
    message.Parent = workspace
    
	for i = 1, #fullText do
		local a = Instance.new("Sound")
		a.SoundId = "rbxassetid://9120299506"
		a:Play()
		a.Parent = workspace
        message.Text = string.sub(fullText, 1, i)
		task.wait(0.05) -- wait between each letter
	a:Destroy()
    end
    
	task.wait(3) -- set how long you want it to stay
	
    message:Destroy()

scripts.title: Drop Tool with Q
scripts.script:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local function dropIstupiditem(player)
    local character = player.Character
    if character then
        local tool = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
        if tool then
            tool.Parent = game.Workspace
            tool.Position = character.HumanoidRootPart.Position + Vector3.new(0, 5, 0)
        end
    end
end

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
    if not gameProcessed and input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Q then -- Keybind
        local player = Players.LocalPlayer
        dropIstupiditem(player)
    end
end)

scripts.title: Body Transparency Client Side
scripts.script:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

local function applyTransparency()
    local character = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not character then return end


    for _, part in ipairs(character:GetChildren()) do
        if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.Name ~= "Head" then
            part.Transparency = 0.9 -- Body Transparency 
			        elseif part.Name == "Head" then
            part.Transparency = 1 --Head Transparency
        end
    end

    local head = character:FindFirstChild("Head")
    if head then
        local face = head:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Decal")
        if face then
            face:Destroy()
        end
    end

    for _, item in ipairs(character:GetChildren()) do
        if item:IsA("Accessory") or item:IsA("Clothing") then
            item.Handle.Transparency = 1
        end
    end
end

LocalPlayer.CharacterAppearanceLoaded:Connect(function()
    applyTransparency()
end)

LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
    task.wait(1)
    applyTransparency()
end)

task.wait(1)
applyTransparency()
